# Mixed-column reuse

The three original `.bend` files are unchanged Apache-2.0 fixtures from
[bendlang/bend at e6676b0](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/flatten).
Their Base imports, +b reuse annotation, comments and golden forms are preserved.
The 39 application rows cover depths 0..2, not arbitrary constructor depths.
New observation/IO wrappers use MPL-2.0. They supply no parity credit for the
separately unresolved imported-constructor printing discrepancy.
